modes.definition_zh: 人性即天理，天命之性纯善。 程颐首次系统论证'性即理也'命题：天理下贯于人即为性，性善根源于理之本然。此法将人性的形上根据锚定于宇宙本体，使道德本体论获得超越经验的支撑。气禀之性的引入解释了恶的来源——理虽本善，但气有清浊，禀受不同故有善恶之分。此命题成为朱熹'天命之性'与'气质之性'二元结构的直接来源，是宋明人性论的基石。
modes.definition_en: Nature is principle: the heavenly principle descends into humanity as nature, and nature is good because principle is originally good. Cheng Yi systematically established 'nature is principle' as the metaphysical foundation of ethics. The introduction of 'temperamental nature' explains evil — principle is pure but qi is turbid, so endowments vary and good/evil emerge. This proposition became the direct source for Zhu Xi's dual structure of 'invested nature' and 'physical nature', forming the cornerstone of Song-Ming theory of human nature.
process_zh: 确认人性根源于天理而非气质
区分天命之性与气质之性
理解恶的来源在于气禀之偏而非本性之恶
通过变化气质恢复本然之善
process_en: Confirm that human nature derives from principle, not from temperamental endowment
Distinguish invested nature from physical nature
Understand that evil originates from turbid qi, not from original nature
Transform temperamental endowment to restore original goodness
modes.key_quote_zh: 性即理也，何谓性？曰：天道焉而行乎人者也，谓之道。在天为命，在义为理，在人为性，主于身为心，其实一也。
modes.key_quote_en: Nature is principle. What is nature? It is the heavenly way functioning in humanity. In heaven it is called mandate, in righteousness it is called principle, in humanity it is called nature, governing the body it is called heart-mind — in essence they are one.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'性即理也'命题成为理学人性论的基石：天理下贯于人即为性，性本善根源于理之本然
引入'气禀'解释恶的来源：理虽本善，但气有清浊，禀受不同故有善恶之分
朱熹继承并发展为'天命之性'与'气质之性'的二元结构，成为此后八百年人性论的标准范式
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'nature is principle' became the cornerstone of Neo-Confucian theory of human nature: heavenly principle descends into humanity as nature, goodness rooted in principle's original purity
The 'temperamental endowment' explanation for evil: principle is pure but qi varies in clarity and turbidity, so endowments differ and good/evil emerge
Zhu Xi inherited and developed this into the dual structure of 'invested nature' and 'physical nature', becoming the standard paradigm for eight centuries

modes.definition_zh: 以'敬'为入道之门，通过庄敬存养收束身心。'敬'不是静态的虚无，而是'主一无适'的专注状态——心有所主，不旁骛他物。'入道莫如敬'，'学者莫若且先理会得敬'。敬是对治心散、气浮的根本工夫，通过'居敬'使内心常存主宰，喜怒哀乐未发时保持'中'的状态，已发时保持'和'的状态。此法是程颐工夫论的起点，与'格物穷理'互为表里。
modes.definition_en: Reverence as the gate to the Way: through solemn nurturing, one gathers body and mind. 'Reverence' is not static emptiness but 'single-minded focus' — the heart has its master and does not stray. 'Nothing leads into the Way like reverence.' It is the fundamental practice against scattered mind and floating qi. Through 'dwelling in reverence,' the heart maintains its mastery constantly; before emotional arousal one preserves the 'mean,' and after arousal the 'harmony.' This method is Cheng Yi's starting point in cultivation, paired with 'investigating things to extend knowledge.'
modes.source_chapter: 《河南程氏遗书》卷二上、卷十八
process_zh: 确立'敬'为入道之门——收束身心、不旁骛物
在未发时保持庄敬存养，使心体清明
在已发时以敬节制情感，使发而中节
持之以恒使庄敬成为日常习惯
process_en: Establish reverence as the gate to the Way — gathering body and mind without straying
Maintain solemn nurturing when emotions are unaroused, keeping the heart clear
Apply reverence to moderate emotions when aroused, ensuring appropriate expression
Sustain this consistently until reverence becomes daily habit
modes.key_quote_zh: 涵养须用敬，进学则在致知。敬则自虚静，不可把虚静唤做敬。君子庄敬日强，安肆日偷。
modes.key_quote_en: Nurturing must use reverence; advancing learning lies in extending knowledge. Reverence brings natural stillness — one must not mistake stillness for reverence. The gentleman grows strong daily through solemn reverence; the lax and careless grow mean.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐强调'敬'是'圣门第一义'，朱熹称'程先生所以有功于后学者，最是敬之一字有力'
程颐批评只守一个敬不知集义则是都无事——敬需配合穷理方为完整工夫
朱熹终身持守'主敬'工夫：'敬字工夫，乃圣门第一义，彻头彻尾，不可顷刻间断'
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi emphasized 'reverence' as 'the first principle in the sage's school'; Zhu Xi said 'Cheng's greatest contribution is the character reverence alone'
Cheng Yi warned that merely holding reverence without gathering righteousness is empty — reverence must be paired with investigating things
Zhu Xi held 'reverence' as lifelong practice: 'Reverence is the first principle, from beginning to end, never to be interrupted for a moment'
modern_applications_zh: 冥想与正念的哲学基础
modern_applications_en: Philosophical foundation for meditation and mindfulness

modes.name_en: Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge Method
modes.definition_zh: 格物即穷理——通过观察事物、读书明理来扩充知识，最终达到'豁然贯通'。'今日格一件，明日格一件，积习既多，然后脱然有贯通处'。此法强调渐进积累的认知路径：不要求穷尽天下万物，只需每日格一件，积累多了自然贯通。它同时承认'闻见之知'的价值，主张通过多读书、多学习来辅助德性之知的显现。这是程颐对《大学》'格物致知'的系统阐释，也是程朱理学认识论的核心。
modes.definition_en: Investigating things is exhausting principle — through observing phenomena and studying classics to extend knowledge, ultimately achieving 'sudden thorough comprehension.' 'Today investigate one thing, tomorrow another; after accumulation grows abundant, then suddenly there is thorough comprehension.' This method emphasizes gradual cognitive accumulation: one need not exhaust all things under heaven, only investigate one thing daily, and after sufficient accumulation, thorough comprehension occurs naturally. It also acknowledges the value of 'empirical knowledge,' advocating reading and study to assist the manifestation of 'moral knowledge.' This is Cheng Yi's systematic interpretation of 'investigating things to extend knowledge' from the Great Learning, and the core of Cheng-Zhu epistemology.
modes.source_chapter: 《河南程氏遗书》卷十八、卷二十五
process_zh: 确立'格物即穷理'的认知目标
每日观察一事物、研读一经书，积累物理
通过持续积累达到'脱然贯通'
贯通之后，未见者亦能推知
process_en: Establish 'investigating things is exhausting principle' as the cognitive goal
Observe one thing daily, study one classic, accumulating knowledge of principles
Through sustained accumulation reach 'sudden thorough comprehension'
After thorough comprehension, even unobserved things can be inferred
modes.key_quote_zh: 须是今日格一件，明日格一件，积习既多，然后脱然有贯通处。
modes.key_quote_en: One must investigate one thing today, another tomorrow; after accumulated practice becomes abundant, then suddenly there is thorough comprehension.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'今日格一件，明日格一件'——渐进积累的认知方法论，区别于顿悟路径
区分'闻见之知'与'德性之知'：闻见之知来自感官接触，德性之知乃内心固有
朱熹继承发展为'即物穷理'的方法论：格物不止一事，穷理不止一理
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'today one thing, tomorrow another' — gradual accumulative cognitive methodology, distinct from sudden enlightenment paths
Distinction between 'empirical knowledge' and 'moral knowledge': empirical knowledge comes from sensory contact, moral knowledge is innately present
Zhu Xi inherited and developed this into 'investigating things to exhaust principle' methodology

modes.definition_zh: '体用一源，显微无间'——理（体/微）与象（用/显）同源同体，不可分离。程颐在《周易程氏传序》中提出此命题，作为易学诠释的根本原则：通过有形之象把握无形之理，理在象中而不离象。这不仅是易学方法论，更是整个理学的形上学架构：现象与本质不二，形式与内容统一，理论与实践一致。'有理而后有象，有象而后有数'——理为本，象为数皆依理而立。
modes.definition_en: 'Body and function share one origin, subtle and manifest have no interval' — principle (body/subtle) and image (function/manifest) share one source and cannot be separated. Cheng Yi proposed this in the Preface to his Commentary on the Yijing as the fundamental principle of Yijing interpretation: through visible images grasp invisible principle, principle exists within images without departing from them. This is not merely Yijing methodology but the entire Neo-Confucian metaphysical architecture: phenomenon and essence are non-dual, form and content unified, theory and practice consistent.
process_zh: 理解体用一源：理与象同源不可分
掌握'因象以明理'的诠释路径
在具体情境中把握理与象的统一
以'一源'思维统摄理论与实践
process_en: Understand body-function one origin: principle and image share source and are inseparable
Master the hermeneutic path of 'illuminating principle through images'
Grasp the unity of principle and image in concrete situations
Unify theory and practice through 'one origin' thinking
modes.key_quote_zh: 至微者理也，至著者象也。体用一源，显微无间。
modes.key_quote_en: The most subtle is principle; the most manifest is image. Body and function share one origin; subtle and manifest have no interval.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐《周易程氏传》以'体用一源'统摄全篇：通过卦象阐释天理，以理释象、以象显理
此命题成为程朱易学的核心方法论，直接影响朱熹'即物穷理'的认识论
反例警示：若将体用割裂为二，则陷入形而上学与经验主义的二元对立——程颐正是以'一源'突破这一困境
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's Commentary uses 'body-function one origin' to unify the whole: through hexagram images elucidate heavenly principle, using principle to explain images and images to reveal principle
This proposition became the core methodology of Cheng-Zhu Yijing studies, directly influencing Zhu Xi's epistemology
Counterexample: severing body and function into two leads to the dualism of metaphysics and empiricism — Cheng Yi broke through this predicament with 'one origin'
modern_applications_zh: 本质与现象的统一思维

modes.domain_zh: 普遍性与特殊性/形上学
modes.definition_zh: '天下只有一个理'，但此理在不同事物中有不同表现。'一物之理即万物之理'——普遍之理在具体事物中各有分殊。此法解决'一'与'多'的关系：理是一，但万物各得其理；万物各异，但理无二致。这一原理后来被朱熹发展为'月印万川'的经典比喻：一月普现一切水，一切水月一月摄。
modes.definition_en: 'The whole world has only one principle,' but this principle manifests differently in different things. 'The principle of one thing is the principle of all things' — universal principle has particular manifestations in each entity. This method resolves the relationship between 'one' and 'many': principle is one, yet all things each receive their own principle; all things differ, yet principle is undivided. This principle was later developed by Zhu Xi into the classic metaphor of 'the moon reflected in ten thousand rivers': one moon appears in all waters, all waters' moons are but one moon.
process_zh: 确认万物共具一理
理解理在不同事物中的分殊表现
在具体情境中把握理的特定表现形式
避免将'一'抽象化为脱离具体的空泛概念
process_en: Confirm that all things share one principle
Understand how principle manifests differently across entities
Grasp the particular form of principle in concrete situations
Avoid reducing 'one' to an empty abstraction detached from particulars
modes.key_quote_zh: 散之在万殊，万殊原于一理。理一分殊。
modes.key_quote_en: Scattered among myriad particularities, all particularities originate from one principle. One principle, many manifestations.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'天下只有一个理'——普遍之理在不同事物中各有分殊
朱熹以'月印万川'比喻理一分殊：一月普现一切水，一切水月一月摄
反例警示：若只执'理一'忽略'分殊'，则会陷入抽象普遍主义；若只执'分殊'忽略'理一'，则会陷入相对主义
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'the world has only one principle' — universal principle manifests differently across entities
Zhu Xi's 'moon reflected in ten thousand rivers' metaphor: one moon appears in all waters, all waters' moons are but one
Counterexample: fixating on 'one principle' while ignoring 'many manifestations' leads to abstract universalism; fixating on 'manifestations' while ignoring 'one principle' leads to relativism
modern_applications_zh: 统一标准下的个性尊重

modes.name_en: Gradual Accumulation to Sudden Insight Method
modes.definition_zh: 认知的渐进路径：'今日格一件，明日格一件，积习既多，然后脱然有贯通处'。程颐强调从量的积累到质的飞跃：不需要穷尽天下万物，只需每日格一件，积累多了自然'贯通'。此法既不同于顿悟论（不要求一次性彻悟），也不同于经验主义的机械积累（强调最终的质变飞跃）。'贯通'不是归纳推理，而是直觉性的'豁然开朗'，是长期积累后的认知跃迁。
modes.definition_en: The gradual path of cognition: 'Today investigate one thing, tomorrow another; after accumulation grows abundant, then suddenly there is thorough comprehension.' Cheng Yi emphasizes moving from quantitative accumulation to qualitative transformation. One need not exhaust all things under heaven — only investigate one thing daily, and after sufficient accumulation, 'thorough comprehension' occurs naturally. This method differs from both sudden enlightenment (no single moment of total awakening required) and mechanical empiricism (emphasizing the qualitative leap at the end). 'thorough comprehension' is not inductive reasoning but intuitive 'sudden clarity' — a cognitive leap after prolonged accumulation.
process_zh: 确立渐进积累的认知态度
每日格一件，不急于求成
在持续积累中等待'贯通'时刻
贯通后，未见者亦能推知
process_en: Establish gradual accumulative cognitive attitude
Investigate one thing daily, do not rush for results
Wait for the moment of 'thorough comprehension' amid sustained accumulation
After thorough comprehension, even unobserved things can be inferred
modes.key_quote_zh: 须是今日格一件，明日格一件，积习既多，然后脱然有贯通处。
modes.key_quote_en: One must investigate one thing today, another tomorrow; after accumulated practice becomes abundant, then suddenly there is thorough comprehension.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'今日格一件，明日格一件'——渐进积累的认知方法论
朱熹继承发展为'今日格一物，明日格一物'的日用工夫
反例警示：若把渐进理解为无限延长，则会陷入'终日格物'却无贯通的空转——程颐同时强调'贯通处'的质变时刻
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'today one thing, tomorrow another' — gradual accumulative cognitive methodology
Zhu Xi inherited and developed this into daily practice of 'investigating one thing today, another tomorrow'

Counterexample: if gradual accumulation is understood as infinite prolongation, one enters idle spinning without thorough comprehension — Cheng Yi simultaneously emphasizes the qualitative leap moment of 'thorough comprehension'

modes.definition_zh: '存天理，灭人欲'——通过去除私欲恢复天理本性。人欲是天理的遮蔽，'无人欲即皆天理'。此法强调道德修养的目标是去除私欲、恢复本然之善。'饿死事极小，失节事极大'——在极端情境下，保存天理比保全生命更重要。程颐的这一命题成为程朱理学的核心道德规范，但也因其严苛性而备受争议。
modes.definition_en: 'Preserve heavenly principle, eliminate human desires' — through removing selfish desires, restore original heavenly principle nature. Human desires obscure heavenly principle; 'where there are no desires, all is principle.' This method emphasizes that the goal of moral cultivation is removing selfish desires to restore original goodness. 'To starve to death is a small matter; to lose one's moral integrity is a great matter' — in extreme situations, preserving principle matters more than preserving life. Cheng Yi's proposition became the core moral norm of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism, but has also been heavily controversial due to its severity.
process_zh: 识别天理与人欲的区别
觉察内心私欲的萌动
通过主敬涵养去除私欲
恢复天理本然之善
process_en: Identify the distinction between heavenly principle and human desires
Detect the stirring of selfish desires in the heart
Remove desires through reverence and nurturing
Restore original heavenly principle goodness
modes.key_quote_zh: 人心私欲也，道心天理也。……无人欲即皆天理矣。饿死事极小，失节事极大。
modes.key_quote_en: Human mind is selfish desire; dao mind is heavenly principle. ... Where there are no desires, all is heavenly principle. To starve to death is a small matter; to lose moral integrity is a great matter.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'饿死事极小，失节事极大'——将道德节操置于生命之上
'无人欲即皆天理'——欲望是理之遮蔽，去除欲望即是恢复天理
反例警示：若把'灭欲'推向极端，会陷入禁欲主义——程颐同时强调'理'本身包含正当的人之常情，灭的是'私欲'而非'人欲'本身
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'to starve to death is small, to lose integrity is great' — placing moral integrity above life itself
'Where there are no desires, all is heavenly principle' — desires obscure principle; removing desires is restoring heavenly principle

Counterexample: pushing 'eliminating desires' to the extreme leads to asceticism — Cheng Yi simultaneously emphasized that 'principle' itself contains legitimate human feelings; what is eliminated is 'selfish desire' not 'human desire' itself

modes.definition_zh: 以知为本、先知后行——'能知则能行，行是知的结果'。程颐在知行关系上主张知优先于行：必须先明理，然后才能正确行动。这与陆王心学'知行合一'的路径不同。程颐强调'学莫先于致知'，认为没有正确的认知指导，行动就会迷失方向。但'知'不是外在的经验知识，而是对天理的内在本性的体认。
modes.definition_en: Knowledge precedes action: 'to know is to be able to act; action is the result of knowing.' Cheng Yi holds that knowledge takes priority over action in the knowledge-action relationship: one must first understand principle, then act correctly. This differs from Lu-Wang 'unity of knowledge and action.' Cheng Yi emphasizes 'learning has no priority over extending knowledge,' believing that without correct cognitive guidance, action goes astray. But 'knowledge' here is not external empirical knowledge, but the inner apprehension of heavenly principle's original nature.
process_zh: 确立知的优先地位
通过格物穷理获得真知
以真知指导行动
在实践中检验和深化认知
process_en: Establish the priority of knowledge
Obtain true knowledge through investigating things and exhausting principle
Guide action through true knowledge
Test and deepen cognition through practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 学莫先于致知。致知在格物。……能知则能行，行是知的结果。
modes.key_quote_en: Learning has no priority over extending knowledge. Extending knowledge lies in investigating things. ... To know is to be able to act; action is the result of knowledge.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'学莫先于致知'——知识的优先性
'真知'与'闻见之知'的区分：真知乃德性之知，不假见闻
朱熹继承发展为'知轻重心重'的知行观，影响后世数百年
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'learning has no priority over extending knowledge' — the priority of knowledge
Distinction between 'true knowledge' and 'empirical knowledge': true knowledge is moral knowledge, not dependent on sensory experience
Zhu Xi inherited and developed this into 'knowledge is light, action is heavy' view of knowledge-action, influencing later centuries

modes.definition_zh: 以《大学》为'初学入德之门'，通过经典学习进入道德修养。程颐特别重视《大学》，认为它是儒家入门的经典。'《大学》，孔氏之遗书，而初学入德之门也。' 他主张读书须'晓其文义，然后求其意'，反对脱离经文的空谈。此法强调经典学习与实践体认的结合：读书明理不是终点，而是通向道德实践的起点。
modes.definition_en: Using the Great Learning as the 'gateway to virtue for beginners,' one enters moral cultivation through classical study. Cheng Yi particularly valued the Great Learning, regarding it as the gateway classic of Confucianism. 'The Great Learning is the legacy book of Confucius and the gateway to virtue for beginners.' He insisted that reading must first 'understand the literal meaning, then seek its import,' opposing empty talk divorced from classics. This method emphasizes the combination of classical study and practical apprehension: studying classics to understand principle is not the end but the starting point toward moral practice.
process_zh: 以《大学》为入门经典
读书须先晓文义，再求其意
将经典学习与道德实践结合
以经学为根基确保理论的正当性
process_en: Take the Great Learning as the gateway classic
Reading must first grasp literal meaning, then seek its import
Combine classical study with moral practice
Use classical learning as foundation to ensure theoretical legitimacy
modes.key_quote_zh: 《大学》，孔氏之遗书，而初学入德之门也。……凡看文字，先须晓其文义，然后可求其意。
modes.key_quote_en: The Great Learning is Confucius's legacy book and the gateway to virtue for beginners. ... When reading any text, one must first understand its literal meaning, then one can seek its import.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐将《大学》列为'入德之门'，确立其为初学者必读经典
程颐强调'晓文义然后求其意'——反对脱离文本的空谈和臆测
朱熹继承发展为'四书'体系，《大学》始终居于核心地位
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi placed the Great Learning as the 'gateway to virtue,' establishing it as the essential gateway classic for beginners
Cheng Yi emphasized 'first understand literal meaning, then seek its import' — opposing empty talk and speculation divorced from texts
Zhu Xi inherited and developed this into the 'Four Books' system, with the Great Learning remaining central

modes.definition_zh: '敬以直内，义以方外'——内在的敬与外在的义统一于同一理。程颐强调内外本不二：敬是内在的涵养工夫，义是外在的处事准则，二者皆本于同一'理'。'合内外之道也'——内在修养与外在行为必须一致，不可割裂。此法反对'内敬外义'的割裂理解，强调内外一贯。
modes.definition_en: 'Reverence makes the interior straight, righteousness squares the exterior' — inner reverence and outer righteousness are unified in the same principle. Cheng Yi emphasized inner and outer are fundamentally not two: reverence is inner nurturing practice, righteousness is outer conduct standard, both rooted in the same 'principle.' 'This is the way of unifying inner and outer' — inner cultivation and outer behavior must be consistent, cannot be severed. This method opposes the severed understanding of 'inner reverence, outer righteousness,' emphasizing inner-outer consistency.
process_zh: 确立敬为内在修养的根本
确立义为外在行为的准则
理解敬义本是一理的两面
在实践中保持内外一致
process_en: Establish reverence as the root of inner cultivation
Establish righteousness as the standard of outer conduct
Understand that reverence and righteousness are two aspects of one principle
Maintain inner-outer consistency in practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 敬以直内，义以方外。敬义夹持，上下立矣。……合内外之道也。
modes.key_quote_en: Reverence makes the interior straight, righteousness squares the exterior. Reverence and righteousness supporting each other — the upper and lower are established. ... This is the way of unifying inner and outer.
representative_cases_zh: 程颐'敬以直内，义以方外'——敬义本是一事的两面
与张载'太虚即气'对比：程颐以'理'统摄内外，张载以'气'统摄内外
反例警示：若把敬义理解为先后工序（先敬后义或先义后敬），则会错失其同时性——敬义本是一理的两面
representative_cases_en: Cheng Yi's 'reverence makes the interior straight, righteousness squares the exterior' — reverence and righteousness are two aspects of one thing
Contrast with Zhang Zai's 'Tai Xu is qi': Cheng Yi unifies inner-outer through 'principle,' Zhang Zai through 'qi'
Counterexample: reading reverence and righteousness as sequential steps (first reverence then righteousness, or vice versa) misses their simultaneity — they are two aspects of one principle
modern_applications_zh: 职业道德与个人品格的统一
modern_applications_en: Unity of professional ethics and personal character
Practice of unity of knowledge and action

cross_references.description_zh: 程颐与程颢同为理学奠基人，但路径不同：程颢以'识仁为先'、'动亦定静亦定'为工夫入口，重顿悟本体；程颐以'主敬涵养'、'格物穷理'为工夫路径，重渐进积累。朱熹评'明道如大地，伊川如秋霜'——明道气象宽平，伊川严肃精密。二人同以'天理'为核心，但工夫论迥异：明道重'体认'，伊川重'积累'。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi are co-founders of Neo-Confucianism but differ in approach: Cheng Hao uses 'recognizing ren first' and 'settled in motion and stillness' as cultivation entry points, emphasizing sudden apprehension of the ground; Cheng Yi uses 'reverence-nurturing' and 'investigating things to exhaust principle' as the cultivation path, emphasizing gradual accumulation. Zhu Xi evaluated: 'Mingdao is like the great earth, Yichuan like autumn frost' — Mingdao's demeanor is broad and calm, Yichuan is solemn and precise. Both take 'heavenly principle' as core, but their cultivation theories diverge: Mingdao emphasizes 'apprehension,' Yichuan emphasizes 'accumulation.'

cross_references.description_zh: 二程少年时奉父命从周敦颐问学一年余。周敦颐令二程'寻孔颜乐处'，这一追问成为二程终身受用的根本问题。程颢答为'仁者浑然与物同体'，程颐则以'性即理也'回应。周敦颐的'主静'工夫被程颐翻转为'主敬'——静不再是特权状态，任何处境中皆可修养。师授之问与弟子之答构成理学工夫论的代际完成。
cross_references.description_en: The two Chengs studied under Zhou Dunyi for over a year in their youth. Zhou posed 'seek the joy of Confucius and Yan Hui,' which became the fundamental question both brothers carried throughout life. Cheng Hao answered 'forming one body with all things'; Cheng Yi responded with 'nature is principle.' Zhou's 'primary stillness' cultivation was transformed by Cheng Yi into 'primary reverence' — stillness is no longer a privileged state; cultivation is possible in any situation. The teacher's question and the disciples' answers constitute the generational completion of Neo-Confucian cultivation theory.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颐与张载的哲学争论：张载以'太虚即气'为本体论，程颐以'性即理也'为本体论。张载认为'理'是气的运行规律，程颐认为'理'是先于气的宇宙本体。这一争论影响了后世理气关系的讨论，成为宋明理学内部的重要分歧。程颐评张载《西铭》为'横渠文之纯'，但二人本体论路径不同。
cross_references.description_en: The philosophical debate between Cheng Yi and Zhang Zai: Zhang Zai takes 'Tai Xu is qi' as ontology; Cheng Yi takes 'nature is principle' as ontology. Zhang Zai holds that 'principle' is qi's operating pattern; Cheng Yi holds that 'principle' is the cosmic ground prior to qi. This debate influenced later discussions on the li-qi relationship and became an important internal division in Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism. Cheng Yi praised Zhang Zai's Western Inscription as 'Hengqu's purest writing,' yet their ontological paths differed.

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲对程朱理学的批判性继承：黄宗羲反对程朱'理在气先'的二元论，主张'理在气中'。但他继承了程颐'格物穷理'的方法论，将其发展为'史料考辨法'。黄宗羲的'一本万殊法'与程颐的'理一分殊'形成有趣的对话：一个强调多元包容，一个强调一理统摄。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi's critical inheritance of Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism: Huang opposed Cheng-Zhu's dualism of 'principle prior to qi,' advocating 'principle within qi.' Yet he inherited Cheng Yi's 'investigating things to exhaust principle' methodology, developing it into his 'historical source criticism method.' Huang Zongxi's 'one essence many manifestations' forms an interesting dialogue with Cheng Yi's 'one principle many manifestations': one emphasizes pluralistic tolerance, the other emphasizes one principle's overarching unity.
